summary: Lookout on Warbonnet Peak, Converse County, Wyoming, listed as gone by firelookout.org; summit lies on a patented mining claim per a climbing guide.

facts.status_note: Listed as gone on firelookout.org only; the firelookout.com page read gives no status.

access.note: A climbing guide says the summit and its sides lie on a patented mining claim with absent owners. The guide does not say whether visitors are allowed; this level is inferred from the patented-claim wording.

notes_for_editor: Almost no history found: two inventory listings and one climbing guide. The searches returned no build, staffing or removal record. The firelookout.com page gives no status; the gone marking rests on firelookout.org alone. Medicine Bow National Forest comes from firelookout.com and was not checked against a Forest Service source. The 'private' access level is inferred from the patented-claim wording and should be checked before publication. Fact-check 2026-10-10: the climbing page has a photo caption, 'Summit BM on Warbonnet Peak'; it is not described as a lookout structure, and the story now says no source describes one. 'Named owner' was changed to 'absent owners': the guide names only absent landlords tied to Monarch Warbonnet Mining.
